n_states_rationale: The actions and observed windows reveal 6 distinct recurring goals: preparing the coffee machine/water, loading and brewing the coffee capsule, preparing and frothing the milk, adding milk to the coffee and stirring, cleaning up equipment, and discarding waste. Using 6 states avoids generic grouping while completely capturing all procedural steps.

states.name: prepare water tank
states.definition: Filling and attaching the water tank to the coffee machine.

states.name: load coffee capsule
states.definition: Opening the machine compartment, inserting the coffee capsule, and locking it in place.

states.name: brew coffee
states.definition: Placing the cup and pressing the button to brew the coffee.

states.name: froth milk
states.definition: Pouring milk into the frother, operating the frother, and preparing it for pouring.

states.name: mix milk and coffee
states.definition: Pouring the frothed milk into the mug and stirring it together with a wooden stirrer.

states.name: clean and tidy
states.definition: Rinsing and washing equipment, disposing of waste in the bin, and putting away items.

_leak_check.note: recipe steps were NOT provided to the LLM; this compares the independently-derived state count against the card after the fact.
